title: FlowWeb links keep their source in GA4

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: GA4 page_location keeps utm_source/utm_medium only for a closed list of pairs (lib/analytics/sanitize.ts:224 and the browser copy at :256). FlowWeb short links carry utm_source=flowweb (lib/flowweb/short-link.ts:34), which is not on the list, so the main outbound channel shows in GA4 and Google Ads as direct or referral. Fix: add the flowweb pairs FlowWeb actually sends to both copies of the allowlist.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
